Q: Thank you for agreeing to give a recorded statement today. Please state your full name and spell your last name
for the record.
A: I'd rather not say my name on tape, if that's okay. I can answer the questions though.
Q: Understood. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?
A: We were in the parking lot of a shopping center in Pearland, Texas. I was in the front passenger seat of my sister's
sedan. She was backing out of a space.
Q: Was the vehicle moving at the time of impact?
A: Yes, slowly. She was reversing and the other car came down the aisle fairly fast and hit the rear driver's side door.
Q: Did you have your seatbelt on?
A: Yes, I always do.
Q: What happened to your body during the impact?
A: I put my arm out to brace against the dashboard. My right wrist hit the glove box area pretty hard.
Q: Did you go to a doctor or emergency room afterward?
A: Yes, that same evening. They took X-rays and said the wrist was fractured. I've been in a splint since then and I'm
scheduled for a follow-up next week.
Q: Have you had any prior injuries to that wrist?
A: No, nothing I can recall. It was fine before this.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add about the incident?
A: Only that I'm having trouble typing and doing my job right now, so the time off has been hard on me.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
</page>

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
